forecast_anchor.latest_reviewed_period: Q1-2026 (three months ended 31 March 2026), interim filing — the statements themselves are not held
forecast_anchor.latest_reviewed_source: THE STUDY HOLDS NO COMPANY FINANCIAL STATEMENT, AND THIS FIELD SAYS SO RATHER THAN NAMING A FILING. The Q1-2026 figures reach this model as press coverage of the interim filing lodged with the exchange — revenue EGP 2,094 mn, cost of sales EGP 1,975 mn, gross profit EGP 119.066mn and operating profit EGP 1.429mn — not as the reviewed statements. EBITDA is that operating profit plus a depreciation add-back of EGP 25.0mn, which is this study's own estimate for the quarter and not a disclosed line. The issuer's statement index lists nothing after 30 September 2025 and nothing consolidated after 31 December 2020, every consolidated file it does list sits on a host that no longer resolves, and this study models consolidated figures; the position is carried in the escalation register and was re-probed on 5 September 2026 rather than taken on report. So the anchor is recorded and its provenance is not of the class the source rule requires — a condition of the study, not of this record.

other_framing.label: operating margin — no depreciation add-back on either side
other_framing.note: RECORDED BECAUSE THE HEADLINE RATE CARRIES A HOUSE ESTIMATE AND THE VERDICT SHOULD BE SHOWN NOT TO TURN ON IT. Strip the add-back from both sides and the shape is identical: 0.0682% in the quarter against 2.7872% in the first forecast year, rising to 11.00% by FY2030E. The bound is exact — the quarterly add-back would have to exceed EGP 84.2mn, an annualised EGP 337 mn against this study's own FY2025 depreciation charge of EGP 75.7mn, before the forecast opened below the quarter at all. No treatment of depreciation available on these numbers reverses the sign.

driver_rate_beside_it.label: conversion EBITDA per tonne (k EGP/t) — the unit rate the forecast is actually built on, margin being an output of it
driver_rate_beside_it.note: THE DRIVER TELLS THE SAME STORY AND IS NOT RECORDED AS THE GOVERNING RATE, for a reason worth stating: its denominator is a volume the company does not disclose, implied through a fabrication uplift that revenue alone does not identify, so it cannot be read off any filing. It opens at 40.0 against 11.3 in the quarter and rises to 135, while the filed years run 110.8 (FY2023), 145.6 (FY2024) and 182.2 (FY2025) — the same shape as the margin: above the quarter, far below every year.

forecast_anchor.note:
THE FORECAST OPENS ABOVE THE LATEST REVIEWED PERIOD AND RISES FROM THERE, SO NEITHER CLAUSE FIRES AND NO MECHANISM IS OWED OR CLAIMED. It opens at 4.09% against 1.26% in the three months to 31 March 2026 — +224% relative — and the path's minimum IS its opening year, running 4.09% / 8.91% / 11.07% / 11.99% / 12.30%.

WHAT SITS EITHER SIDE OF THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THIS STUDY AND A READER SHOULD SEE IT. The anchor quarter is the worst the company has reported: revenue EGP 2,094 mn against EGP 3,723 mn a year earlier, gross margin 5.69% against 33.12%, operating profit EGP 1.429mn against EGP 1,124 mn, and a net loss of EGP 241.6mn against a profit of EGP 451.7mn. A forecast opening above that is the ordinary consequence of not projecting the worst quarter for ever, and it is not evidence of anything. The LAST forecast year is where the answer lives: 12.30% against a reported record of 30.68% (FY2023), 25.33% (FY2024) and 26.54% (FY2025) — 51% relatively below the lowest of the three — and 82% of enterprise value sits in the terminal struck off it. THIS RULE'S TWO COMPARISONS CANNOT REACH THAT NUMBER: one holds the opening year against the latest reviewed period and the other holds the path's minimum against its own opening year, and on a rising path out of a collapsed quarter both pass while the single judgement carrying the valuation goes unexamined. It is examined instead by this study's own dated gap review, which solves the traded price back through these same drivers onto a terminal margin that sits inside the reported range in all three years — a figure that review computes and this model does not, so it is described rather than quoted.

AND THE RECORD IS ONLY AS GOOD AS WHAT IT IS STRUCK ON. The full-year margins quoted above are not filed rates: revenue and net profit are vendor and press prints, and everything between them is solved or typed — the FY2025 EBITDA rests on a finance cost derived to close the profit and loss to a reported net profit, and this study's own review prices that single unsourced input at about 40% of the FY2025 conversion rate the forecast is calibrated against. The comparison this record draws is therefore between a forecast and a reconstruction, and it is recorded in those terms.
